Every icon count on the site is now read back against the catalogs: the landing page, the
drawers and the gallery menu quote 4,373, and a count the catalogs do not hold fails the
Each brand card on the Icons landing states its own total again instead of the shelf total,
and the page says four free sets rather than two.
A Colour row under Background sets the ink: Auto, white, black, indigo, green, red or any
custom colour. Duo and Flat are tinted rather than flattened, so their two tones survive the
Plump Solid becomes Streamline: 997 icons in Line, Duo, Solid and Flat on one page,
switched by a Style row, with Duo and Flat keeping the vendor's own palette.
Export packs only what the selection holds: nothing is selected when the page opens, so it
reads Nothing to export, and Remove all now really leaves nothing behind.
The all-brands page fetches each brand's sheet only as its section comes into view, and
keeps it for the tab, so a revisit fetches none of them.
The count caught up across the shelf: tools, portfolio, download and the all-brands sheet
now say 3,876 icons in four brands, and that sheet derives its licence line from the brand
table instead of claiming both its sets are MIT.
The preview's weight now reaches every set: Phosphor (256-unit grid) and Plump Solid (48)
scale the stroke to their own units, so 1 to 2.5 finally changes them.
Two more brands on the shelf: Phosphor's 1,512 regular outline icons and Streamline's 500
Plump Solid glyphs, both in the app off the same catalogs.
Carries the pages the site serves today, so the app and the shelf read the same; no
The app carries the band as the site draws it, with the descriptor and the tool list on a
The band carries the same two lines on every page, and the phone shows Art • Tools clear
The all-brands sheet works in the app
The Icons bundle stages the two sheet catalogs its All brands page reads, so that page
draws its twelve-per-brand sheet inside the app instead of empty sections.
Opens the site at its new home on Vercel.
The all-brands sheet in the app now downloads one glyph per category from a per-set
sheet instead of both catalogs, so the same twelve picks come down at 103 KB rather
The left pull-down opens with All, and the page behind it travels inside the APK: a tab per
brand over a sheet of twenty icons, one from each category, so the two sets can be read
side by side with the radio off.
The zip estimate moved into the line under the Export button, where the running summary
used to be, and the collected icons now wrap into rows instead of running off the edge of
Double-tap an icon in the sheet and it collects into a tab above it, with Remove selected
and Remove all. Add all takes the whole category, and a category change starts the
selection clean. The line under the preview estimates the zip before you press Export.
Format is a pull-down like the size: SVG, PNG, WEBP or JPG, one at a time, and the copy
button renames itself to match. The two lists never open together.
Your background choice now sticks per brand alongside the format and the size, so a white
tile survives a reload and the exports come back on white.
The export size is now a pull-down holding all six sizes from 32 to 1024px, instead of a row
that had to squeeze. What you pick still carries over to the zip.
Sizes on two rows, and a pasteable PNG
The six export sizes now sit on two rows, so none of them is squeezed. The format and size
you pick are remembered per brand, and on the site copying a raster also puts a PNG on
the clipboard to paste straight into a design tool.
The export size now runs from 32 to 1024px, and one button packs every icon the sheet
shows into a single zip, in the format you picked. Inside the app that zip lands in
Copy hands over the SVG, or a 512px PNG, WEBP or JPG drawn on the black or white
background. The app saves those to Pictures/Icons.
The browser is inset below the status bar and a camera cutout, so the band is no longer
clipped. A page the app does not carry now offers the site address and an Open on the
The preview tile is a black or white swatch now, labelled as such, instead of the palette’s
The category you picked last is restored the next time you open a brand, and All icons
No release note was written for this build.
Both sets filter by their vendor's own categories — Coolicons' 30, Lineicons' 51 — beside the
name filter. The weight control now writes the chosen stroke onto every element, and fills
the dots the stroke would otherwise turn inside out.
Both brands, 1,864 icons, bundled with the pages, the stylesheet and Poppins. WebView on
and the clipboard behave exactly as they do on the site.
A preview tab with weight, size and background, and a copy button that hands over the
All icons sit behind one toggle and scroll inside their own sheet instead of filling the page.
: the browser is inside the APK, so there is nothing to request.

is the APK blob as it sat in the repository at that commit, so a rebuild shows up

Opens the site at its new home on Vercel.
Compress now appears in Android's own share sheet, so a photo or a batch comes
straight from a gallery or camera app into the queue instead of being picked again.
Every heading, label and number is set in Poppins instead of the system font and its mono
The app is indigo with band-grey actions and hairline rules where thick ink borders used to
The dark-mode toggle is gone because the design carries a single palette. Nothing else

the bottom of the list, so anything earlier has no APK in this history to measure.
